The only source I found gives 9–11 mm, but it was a search snippet from Earth.com, and I never verified the Wikipedia figure I cited earlier. The team note says the answer is 20–24 mm or 14–16 mm, and I found no source supporting either range, so I can't confirm the note. The 9–11 mm figure is the best-supported answer I have, but it's unverified and conflicts with the note.

CONFIDENCE: 25
